relations.product: Comirnaty (mRNA COVID-19 vaccine) joint development and commercialization; development costs and gross profits shared equally
relations.quote: Comirnaty is an mRNA-based coronavirus vaccine to help prevent COVID-19, which is jointly developed and commercialized with BioNTech. Pfizer and BioNTech equally share the costs of development for the Comirnaty program.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Eliquis (apixaban) joint development and commercialization alliance
relations.quote: Eliquis (apixaban) is part of the novel oral anticoagulant market and was jointly developed and is commercialized with BMS as an alternative treatment option to warfarin in appropriate patients.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Eliquis (apixaban) supplied by BMS at cost plus a percentage of net sales in certain smaller markets where Pfizer has full commercialization rights
relations.quote: In certain smaller markets we have full commercialization rights and BMS supplies the product to us at cost plus a percentage of the net sales to end-customers.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Xtandi (enzalutamide) development and commercialization collaboration; Astellas holds exclusive commercialization rights outside the U.S.
relations.quote: Xtandi (enzalutamide) is an androgen receptor inhibitor that blocks multiple steps in the androgen receptor signaling pathway within tumor cells that is being developed and commercialized in collaboration with Astellas, which has exclusive commercialization rights for Xtandi outside the U.S.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Padcev (enfortumab vedotin-ejfv) co-development and joint commercialization
relations.quote: Padcev (enfortumab vedotin-ejfv) is a first-in-class ADC that is directed to Nectin-4, a protein located on the surface of cells and highly expressed in bladder cancer, that is being co-developed and jointly commercialized with Astellas.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Orgovyx (relugolix) U.S. development and commercialization with Sumitomo Pharma Switzerland (SMPS); U.S. profits and allowable expenses shared equally
relations.quote: Orgovyx (relugolix) is an oral gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) receptor antagonist for the treatment of adult patients with advanced prostate cancer that is being developed and commercialized with SMPS. The companies equally share profits and allowable expenses in the U.S. for Orgovyx.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Tivdak (tisotumab vedotin-tftv) commercialization collaboration; Pfizer holds U.S. co-promotion rights
relations.quote: Tivdak (tisotumab vedotin-tftv) is commercialized in collaboration with Genmab. Pfizer has co-promotion rights in the U.S.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Emblaveo (aztreonam-avibactam) development collaboration; AbbVie holds exclusive U.S. and Canada commercialization rights
relations.quote: Emblaveo is being developed in collaboration with AbbVie. AbbVie has the exclusive commercialization rights in the U.S. and Canada; Pfizer leads the joint development program and has commercialization rights in all other countries.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: vepdegestrant (PF-07850327) breast cancer drug development collaboration
relations.quote: Vepdegestrant is being developed in collaboration with Arvinas. In September 2025, Arvinas and Pfizer jointly agreed to out-license the commercialization rights to vepdegestrant to a third party.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: VLA15 (PF-07307405) Lyme disease vaccine candidate development collaboration
relations.quote: VLA15 is being developed in collaboration with Valneva SE.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Ngenla licensed from OPKO Health; developed and commercialized by Pfizer
relations.quote: Ngenla is licensed from OPKO Health, Inc., and is developed and commercialized by Pfizer, including in the U.S., Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Asia.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: exclusive global ex-China in-license of SSGJ-707/PF-08634404 (PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody) for development, manufacturing and commercialization
relations.quote: In July 2025, we completed an exclusive global, ex-China, in-licensing agreement with 3SBio, a leading Chinese biopharmaceutical company, for the development, manufacturing and commercialization of SSGJ-707/PF-08634404, a bispecific antibody targeting PD-1 and vascular endothelial growth factor, currently undergoing several clinical trials in China. Under the terms of the agreement, 3SBio received an upfront payment of $1.25 billion
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: exclusive global collaboration and in-license of YP05002 (oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist, Phase 1) for chronic weight management
relations.quote: In December 2025, we entered into an exclusive global collaboration and in-license agreement with YaoPharma, a leading innovation-driven global healthcare company, for the development, manufacturing and commercialization of YP05002, a small molecule glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist currently in Phase 1 development for chronic weight management.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: manufacturing and supply agreements (MSAs) from the 2020 Upjohn separation: each party manufactures, labels and packages products for the other
relations.quote: Under the MSAs, Pfizer or Viatris, as the case may be, manufactures, labels and packages products for the other party. The terms of the MSAs range in initial duration from four to seven years post-separation.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Comirnaty COVID-19 vaccine doses for EU member states and certain other countries (supply agreements with BioNTech; amended May 2023 to rephase deliveries annually through 2026)
relations.quote: This includes supply agreements entered into in November 2020 and February and May 2021 with the EC for Comirnaty on behalf of the different EU member states and certain other countries.
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)

relations.product: Paxlovid treatment courses (EUA-labeled supply; amended agreement of October 2023 transitioned Paxlovid to U.S. commercial markets)
relations.quote: In October 2023, we announced an amended agreement with the U.S. government, which facilitated the transition of Paxlovid to traditional commercial markets in the U.S. starting in November 2023
relations.label: Pfizer 10-K (02-26-2026)
